## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready laboratory records, standardizes parameters and analysis-range categories, counts normal/high outcomes by treatment, calculates percentages, and applies simulated Fisher exact tests.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBC`
- `ADLBH`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAM`: laboratory parameter
- `ANRIND`: analysis normal-range indicator
- `ANL01FL`: analysis-record flag
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment
- `ARM in ADSL`: denominator treatment.
